authorization: 2026-10-27 user Proceed; new bounded discriminating investigation, not reuse or renewal of the completed three-level campaign
question: How much of the failed coupled shear recovery is reproduced by the same P2 solid discretization under analytic solid-only end displacements?

hypotheses.solid_discretization: Large error persists in the analytic-boundary solid solve and changes under isolated resolution changes
hypotheses.transition_or_host: Analytic-boundary solid recovery is accurate while the coupled result remains inaccurate
hypotheses.mixed: Both contribute; this experiment does not uniquely prove a connector mechanism or convergence rate

reuse_impact: Only recorded source change since that run is empty-RHS rejection in solid_residuals.py; it cannot affect one-RHS physical solves. Existing failed coupling results are not rerun or relabelled.

allowed_source_changes.impact: Empty-RHS guard only; investigated cases have one RHS

controlled_input: E=1000Pa, nu=0, Q=.001N, global xi=x+1 and span3m; unchanged analytic Saint-Venant displacement/stress from reference harness

routes.nodal_interpolant: Evaluate analytic displacement at actual upstream coefficient locations/components; recover upstream stress. Not a solved FE state or best-approximation lower bound.
routes.analytic_boundary_solve: Prescribe analytic physical displacement at all upstream boundary DOFs on x=0 and x=1, including cubic warping nodal values. Zero body force and free lateral faces. Solve with ANYsolver SolidModel and registered_v2. Exact continuum solution satisfies these boundary data; P2 boundary interpolation/discretization remains part of the measured error. No K*u load substitution.

sampling: ALL quadrature samples with0.25<=x<=0.75; same region and per-component error normalizations as original. Store full samples and controlling-point coordinates; no post-hoc exclusions.
additional_diagnostics: End support force/moment resultants from K*u at prescribed coefficients and actual coordinates. Expected force_z left=-Q/right=+Q; moment_y about each end centroid left=+2Q Nm/right=-Q Nm. Report errors, not an added release gate.

acceptance.claim: Diagnostic discrimination only. No production promotion, no inference of uniform stability, no automatic attribution to interface, no new empirical correction or shear smoothing. Original NO_GO remains.
